# LaunchLog

> LaunchLog is a curated paid directory for indie makers, SaaS founders and tech launches.

LaunchLog helps newly shipped products get discovered through human-reviewed listings, structured data and AI-readable public pages.

Canonical site: https://launchlog.ai

## Public URLs

- Homepage: https://launchlog.ai/
- Pricing: https://launchlog.ai/pricing
- Browse all: https://launchlog.ai/browse-all
- Featured: https://launchlog.ai/featured
- Tech products: https://launchlog.ai/tech-products
- Submit: https://launchlog.ai/submit
- Sitemap: https://launchlog.ai/sitemap.xml

## Planned AI-readable surfaces

- Blog: https://launchlog.ai/blog
- Full context: https://launchlog.ai/llms-full.txt
- Listing pages: https://launchlog.ai/listing/{slug}

## Notes for crawlers and answer engines

Listing pages are designed to expose schema.org JSON-LD, canonical URLs and markdown variants through content negotiation once public listings are live.
